title: #367 Hyper Competition
prompt: Some people claim that competition improves the quality of our private and professional lives. Others believe that being hyper-competitive is bad for individuals and society in general. What is your opinion?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Competition helps people improve their skills and lives.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Strong competition can cause problems for people's personal lives.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Competition helps people improve their skills and achieve better results in their careers.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Competition raises the standards of work and service quality.

angles.en: Competition motivates individuals to work harder and improve their skills, as seen when students study late for better grades.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.

modelPlan.focus: Explore the impact of competition on personal and professional lives, balancing its benefits with potential drawbacks.
keyArguments: Competition can enhance motivation and drive personal growth.
However, excessive competition can lead to negative outcomes such as stress and burnout.
